text:
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: inference-api v3.9.1 -> prod-us-west. Starting post-deploy sniffer suite (prefill, kv-sniff, embed-echo). RunID: sniff-3055554321
lia: seeing a small uptick in /v1/embed 5xxs on the postdeploy dashboard — spike at ~30s, p95 latency otherwise steady.
matt: confirming ~0.6% 502s for /v1/embed from the sniffer samples, concentrated on a single shard. attaching log excerpt.
sara: paste sample? which model/variant did the sniffer hit?
matt: ```[sniffer] 00:30 502 embed /v1/embed model:llama-q4_0a shard:eu1 node:gw-12 request_id=sniff-3055```
jin: FYI fallback policy should have routed embed route to llm-small-quant variant. did fallback trigger?
ops-bot: auto-fallback check: did NOT trigger for route=embed-route-prod. Reason: variant-tag missing from artifact metadata.
lia: :thinking_face: ah — variant tags were omitted from the canary artifact metadata. that would stop the fallback.
sara: recommend pause rollout and pin us-west traffic back to v3.9.0 until we fix the tags. low blast but not zero.
matt: agree. safer to revert and re-run sniffer after patch.
jin: propose graded rollback: shift canary -> old 100% over 120s to avoid capacity thrash.
deploy-bot: Plan accepted. Queuing rollback: `rdctl rollback --service inference-api --to v3.9.0 --region us-west --grace 120s`
eva: I'll run the rollback and monitor. @matt can you prepare a short checklist for the cut?
matt: checklist: 1) pause new traffic 2) trigger rdctl rollback 3) watch sniffer + p95 for 5m 4) confirm fallback config restored
sara: also open tracking ticket and flag telemetry tags: `sniffer.embed.502` and `fallback.missing_tag`.
matt: created issue RD-3219: https://redwood.internal/issue/RD-3219 — contains logs and probe samples.
ops-bot: Rollback started by eva at +20s. Status: draining canary pods, shifting routes.
deploy-bot: Post-deploy sniffer halted for this wave. ETA rollback complete ~3m.
jin: after rollback we should re-run sniffer using the patched artifact builder that includes variant tags. @lia to own verification.
lia: acknowledged — patch is merged in CI, will trigger a quick canary smoke once rollback is done.
sara: :thumbsup: If rollback completes cleanly we'll run 30m post-rollback verification. if not, escalate to SRE runbook.
eva: Rollback complete. Error rate back to baseline, p95 recovered. Monitoring green.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Active version: inference-api v3.9.0 in prod-us-west. Sniffer baseline restored.
matt: thanks. follow-ups: add artifact-tagging check to release checklist and include a preflight CI check.
sara: I'll add note to release notes and ping partners about the brief rollback window.
lia: will re-run the sniffer against the patched artifact and report results in RD-3219.
ops-bot: Closing loop: sniffer run halted during rollback, verification resumed postrollback.
